description: KeepCrypt seal and go-ahead vectors. Generated by tools/verify/vectorgen.py --write-seal-vectors; vectorgen.py --selftest regenerates this file and requires byte equality. Public BIP39 test mnemonics only, never a real seed.

spec.S: PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA512(password = UTF-8 of NFKD(mnemonic), salt = b"mnemonic" (BIP39, empty passphrase), iterations = 2048, length = 64 bytes)
spec.seal_code: top 130 bits of HMAC-SHA256(key = S, msg = b"KCE/v1/seal"), most significant first, as 26 Crockford base32 chars (0123456789ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTVWXYZ); displayed 5-5-5-5-6 joined by '-'
spec.seal_tag: T = SHA256(b"KCE/v1/seal-tag" || the 26 ASCII chars of the code, uppercase, no dashes)
spec.seal_id: first 40 bits of T as 8 Crockford base32 chars
spec.seal_id_braille: the Seal ID in lowercase through braille.json's text rule (UEB grade 1: a number sign opens each run of digits, the grade 1 indicator goes before a letter a-j that follows a digit), as Unicode braille
spec.lookup_prefix: first 5 lowercase hex chars (20 bits) of T
spec.grid: 8 rows x 8 columns; the 32 bits of T[1], T[2], T[3], T[4] (0-based), most significant first, fill columns 0-3 row by row; column 7-c mirrors column c; '#' = bit 1, '.' = bit 0
spec.colour: index T[0] mod 8 into the Okabe-Ito palette #000000, #E69F00, #56B4E9, #009E73, #F0E442, #0072B2, #D55E00, #CC79A7
spec.go_ahead: G = first 40 bits of SHA256(b"KCE/v1/go" || T (32 raw bytes) || n (8 raw bytes)) as 8 Crockford base32 chars; displayed XXXX-XXXX
